# Lygature

> Lygature is a specialized consultancy providing expertise sharing, partnership management, and strategic advisory services for life sciences and healthcare innovation consortia.

Lygature operates across three core service pillars: expertise sharing through dedicated centres (drug discovery, patient involvement, data infrastructure, global health, regulatory innovation, and health law/ethics), partnership management services (coordination, stakeholder engagement, business development), and partnership strategy & advisory (consortium building, proposal writing, organizational design). The organization manages a portfolio of health innovation projects including END2AMR, ILLUMINATE, UNITE4TB, and KITT, with particular focus on FAIR data principles, data governance, and multi-stakeholder collaboration in the European health innovation ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Partnership Management
- Expertise Sharing
- Consortium Building
- Data Infrastructure & Governance
- Global Health Innovation
- Patient and Public Involvement
- Regulatory Innovation
- Stakeholder Engagement
- Project Coordination
- Health Law & Ethics
- FAIR Data Principles
- European Health Data Space
- Proposal Writing & Funding Strategy
- Data Management Plans
- Public-Private Partnerships

## Expertise Sharing Centres

- [Expertise Sharing](https://www.lygature.org/expertise-sharing): Lygature's multidisciplinary expertise in life sciences partnerships
- [Drug Discovery & Development Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/drug-discovery-development-expertise-centre): Supporting therapeutic innovation from idea to access via expertise
- [Patient and Public Involvement Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/patient-and-public-involvement-expertise-centre): Patient and public involvement expertise for healthcare innovation
- [Data Infrastructure Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/data-infrastructure-expertise-centre): Data governance and infrastructure for health research consortia
- [Global Health Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/global-health-expertise-centre): Global health innovation from discovery to access and impact
- [Health Law, Privacy & Ethics Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/health-law-privacy-ethics-expertise-centre): Health law, privacy and ethics guidance for healthcare partnerships
- [Regulatory Innovation Expertise Centre](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/expertise-sharing/regulatory-innovation-expertise-centre): Regulatory innovation expertise for therapeutic solutions access

## Partnership Management Services

- [Partnership Management](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management): Multi-stakeholder partnership management in life sciences sector
- [Project Coordination & Management](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management/project-coordination-management): Project coordination, monitoring and evaluation services
- [Stakeholder Management](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management/stakeholder-management): Stakeholder management for public-private partnerships
- [Business Development & Legal](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management/business-development-legal): Business development and legal frameworks for partnerships
- [Resource Management & Project Legacy](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management/resource-management-project-legacy): Resource management and project sustainability planning
- [Communication](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-management/communication): Communication strategy and stakeholder engagement services

## Partnership Strategy & Consortium Development

- [Partnership Strategy & Advice](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-strategy-advice): Partnership strategy and stakeholder management for consortia
- [Consortium Building](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-strategy-advice/consortium-building): Consortium building in life sciences and healthcare sectors
- [Proposal Writing & Application Management](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-strategy-advice/proposal-writing-application-management): Proposal writing guidance for funders like Horizon Europe, IHI
- [Organization Building](https://www.lygature.org/core-activities/partnership-strategy-advice/organization-building): Organizational structures for public-private partnerships
